title: S6: Zone erase runs after mirroring re-attaches, with no post-erase re-seed

description: Remote data can merge back in before the erase completes, and export metadata may already believe the (about to be erased) rows were uploaded - leaving iCloud either empty or a UNION, never the intended replacement. Contrast: DataStoreResetService erases while fully torn down, then rebuilds - the correct ordering. Severity: High. Wave/Plan: Wave 2, plan 2a migration-transitions. Sweep: sync machinery.
